open_obligations: Check that the 'weak performance' in Lang et al. is the plain weak model or the debate-augmented one.
Check whether the strong ceiling may underestimate achievable gains.
Check that ceilings are computed on the same strong model.
out.other_title: Performance gap recovered (PGR) metric for weak-to-strong generalization
out.rationale: Burns et al. define PGR as the fraction of the performance gap between the weak and strong ceiling models that is recovered with weak supervision, that is (weak-to-strong minus weak) divided by (strong ceiling minus weak). Lang, Huang and Li define PGR with the same formula, so their PGR values are on Burns et al.'s scale.
out.scope: proposed DEPENDS_ON: performance gap recovered as the measure of weak-to-strong success
